beats: Dad's delivery shifts start at a fixed 02:15, but what each one pays was never recorded.
Every month meant redoing pay by hand, from memory, with no record to check.
Now a geofence around the depot catches the moment his phone leaves, and logs the shift itself.
It splits the pay before and after six, skips the unpaid break — no typing required.
A parent can now open the whole month on the kiosk and see exactly which days counted, and why.
